list.title: Stock
list.description: On-hand quantities per product, in base units. Filter to items at or below their reorder level.
list.emptyFiltered: Try clearing the search, category, or low-stock filter.
list.emptyDefault: Record a GRN to bring stock in, then it will appear here.

filter.searchAria: Search stock by name or SKU

grn.title: Goods received (GRN)
grn.description: Quantities are entered in the receive unit and converted to base units for stock.
grn.emptyDescription: Create a product before recording a GRN so there is something to receive against.
grn.supplierHint: Optional — leave as “none” for unattributed stock-in.

adjust.title: Adjustments & returns
adjust.description: Correct stock for damage, wastage, recounts or opening balances, and record sales / purchase returns.
adjust.emptyDescription: Create a product before adjusting stock or recording a return.
adjust.adjustDescription: Damage, wastage, recount or opening stock. A reason is required; OUT is blocked if it would go negative (toggle allow-negative to override).
adjust.returnDescription: Sales return brings goods back in; purchase return sends them back to the supplier.

movements.title: Movement ledger
movements.description: Every stock movement, newest first. KACHA_OUT lines are unattributed stock-outs.
movements.emptyFiltered: No stock movements match the current filters.
movements.emptyDefault: Stock movements appear here once goods are received, adjusted, or sold.

nearExpiry.title: Near expiry
nearExpiry.description: Batches with stock on hand expiring within the next {days} days, soonest first.
nearExpiry.emptyDescription: No batches are expiring within {days} days. Widen the window to look further ahead.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Vendors you receive goods from. Used when recording a GRN.
suppliers.emptyWritable: Add your first supplier using the form above to start recording GRNs against them.
suppliers.emptyReadonly: No suppliers have been added yet.
suppliers.formDescription: Only the name is required; GSTIN, phone and address are optional.
suppliers.name: Name

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.insufficientStock: Not enough stock — this would go negative. Enable allow-negative to override.
errors.fractionalPiece: This unit is piece-type — fractional quantities are not allowed.
errors.idempotencyMismatch: Duplicate request with different data — refresh and retry.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
